description: Welcome to The Arowana Palms, a tropical paradise nestled in Arpora. Experience the perfect blend of relaxation and entertainment in our stunning 5BHK villa, featuring an inviting outdoor pool and bar, lawn, and Full-TIme In-House Chef (Included in the package, just pay for the groceries & gas/fuel charges). Located in the vibrant surroundings of Goa, this property offers the ideal setting for your unforgettable vacation. The space The Arowana Palms is an exquisite villa in The Arowana Villa's Collection, personally managed by the owner Asis Chawla. If this villa is booked on your preferred dates, you can check out our other similar properties. The Arowana Palms is a remarkable 5BHK villa with private pool and outdoor spaces where you can immerse yourself in peace and unwind in your private lawns and bar while enjoying delicious food and drinks all day prepared by your in-house chef (included in the package). Take a glimpse at the spaces that await you: 5 BEDROOMS (2 Bedrooms on Ground Floor + 3 Bedrooms on the first floor) - The villa has 5 AC bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms - TV with satellite connectivity in rooms - Premium linen and bedding for ultimate comfort - Essentials like Wardrobe, convenient charging points in all rooms - Multiple attached balconies, overlooking the private pool BATHROOMS (6 Bathrooms) - The villa has 5 attached + 1 Common Bathroom - The bathrooms have modern fittings and geysers for hot water - Essentials like towels and soaps are provided OUTDOOR SPACES (Balconies, Lawns, and Private Pool) - The villa has a private pool. - Outdoor seating areas for dining and barbeque - Multiple attached balconies with seating arrangements throughout - Lawn areas for outdoor activities OTHER SPACES - AC in the living area for comfortable gatherings - The villa has multiple spaces for your family to gather and talk - Fully equipped kitchen with fridge and microwave - Separate dining area with dining table - Listen to your favorite music indoors with our Bluetooth speaker INDOOR GAMES & POOL - We have indoor games like Carrom at our property - Pool table on the first floor Guest access Our property offers no shared spaces, ensuring that you can enjoy an undisturbed and private stay. During your stay, you will have full access to the entire villa. Parking is available at the property. Other things to note 1. Price includes a full time in house chef. 2. Our properties feature a full-time in-house chef, and guests only need to pay for the cost of groceries & nominal gas charges. 3. Barbeque arrangements can be made on demand 4. Separate serve ware for Veg & Non-Veg food 5. A refundable deposit of INR.10,000 payable at the time of check-in. 6. Inverter and battery backup which subsides the basic electricity needs. 7. 24*7 CCTV Surveillance 8. Smoking is only allowed outdoors 9. Guest capacity should be respected. Unaccounted guests are not allowed. 10. ID Verification is mandatory at the time of check-in 11. No music or any kind of noise allowed throughout the day near the pool or any outdoor areas.
